prompt: A photorealistic photo captures the bustling interior of a vintage train dining car. On the left, a man in a red scarf sits on a velvet bench, his posture relaxed as he holds a silver spoon. Next to him, a woman with curly hair looks at a steaming bowl of soup, her eyes focused on the rising vapor. In the center, a waiter in a crisp white apron stands beside a polished wooden table, handing a glass of red wine to a businessman in a grey suit. The businessman reaches out with his right hand, fingers extended to grasp the stem of the glass. Across from him, an elderly lady with pearl earrings points at the menu, her index finger tapping the paper decisively. A small brown dog sits on the floor near her feet, its tail wagging slightly as it watches a dropped crumb. To the right, a young couple shares a plate of pasta, the man in a blue shirt leaning forward while the woman in a floral dress smiles at him. Behind them, a conductor in a navy uniform checks a pocket watch, his brow furrowed in concentration. A large potted fern stands in the corner, its leaves brushing against the window frame. Outside the window, blurred green fields rush by, indicating speed. A brass lamp hangs from the ceiling, casting a warm glow over the scene. A leather suitcase rests under the seat of the man in the red scarf. A newspaper lies folded on the empty seat next to the elderly lady. A salt shaker sits precariously on the edge of the central table. There is no digital screen visible anywhere in the carriage. There is no modern plastic cutlery present on any table.
